You need a finance‑focused analytics solution that moves raw Shopify, Stripe and Amazon data from Snowflake into reliable dbt models, reconciles revenue to payouts, and delivers a Power BI finance report with a full data dictionary. I recently delivered the Larkspur revenue reporting project where I loaded Shopify orders, refunds and Stripe payouts into Snowflake, built staging, intermediate and mart dbt models with tests on every key, and created a Power BI dataset with a revenue bridge and contribution margin by channel. [7e222d75d59a8e89f4b38102]

I would start by reviewing your current Snowflake schema and Fivetran pipelines, then design the dbt staging and mart models to match your finance definitions. After the models are in place I would develop the Power BI report and data dictionary, and finally run a one‑hour handover session with your finance lead. Could you share a sample of the raw CSV exports you currently use, and confirm whether refunds and fees are already captured in separate tables?

I would also set up automated tests in dbt to catch any drift in revenue calculations and schedule daily runs to keep the Power BI dataset fresh. Do you have any existing naming conventions for Snowflake objects that I should follow?
